mainEntity.name: Is the matching service really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Your Accountant Match is free for individuals and businesses seeking an accountant. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm.

mainEntity.name: Are the accountants you match me with registered?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every accountant in our network is registered with the Tax Practitioners Board (TPB) where required, meaning they are legally authorised to lodge tax returns and represent you to the ATO. We verify TPB registration before any firm joins the network.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get matched?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. You will then be connected directly with the matched firm, who will typically reach out within 2 hours, alternatively you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your needs.

mainEntity.name: Can a tax accountant help with an ATO audit or dispute?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our network includes registered tax agents experienced in ATO audits, reviews, and disputes. When you complete the questionnaire, mention you need audit or dispute support and we will match you with a firm that handles ATO representation.

mainEntity.name: Can a tax accountant help with investment property and CGT?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our network includes agents who prepare depreciation schedules, handle rental property schedules, and advise on capital gains tax when you sell. Mention property or CGT in the questionnaire and we will match you with a firm that specialises in investment property tax.

mainEntity.name: What if I have overdue tax returns?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us in the questionnaire that you have overdue returns. Our network includes registered agents experienced in catch-up work — lodging multiple overdue years, reconstructing records where needed, and requesting penalty remission where mitigating circumstances apply.

mainEntity.name: Can a tax accountant help with tax planning before 30 June?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The best tax advice happens before 30 June — timing a CGT event, structuring a windfall, managing super contributions or pre-paying deductible expenses. Our matched agents offer year-round advice, not just once-a-year filing.

mainEntity.name: How much does a tax accountant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Individual returns typically range from $200 to $400; business and complex returns are higher. The matched agent gives you a clear quote after reviewing your situation. The matching service itself is free.

blocks.heading: Tax Accountant — what we can help with
blocks.text: SPECIALIST NETWORKTax Accountant — what we can help withWhat does a tax accountant actually do?A registered tax accountant lodges returns, manages ATO compliance, and gives strategic advice on how to legally minimise tax. The best ones go beyond filing — they spot deductions you'd miss, flag risks before the ATO does, and plan around your cash flow so you are never caught short. Our matched accountants are all registered with the Tax Practitioners Board, meaning they are legally authorised to lodge returns and deal with the ATO on your behalf.Why matching beats a directory listingGeneric accounting directories list every firm by alphabet or paid placement — not by what you actually need. A business owner with stock and payroll has different requirements to a sole trader contractor, who has different requirements again to a retiree with an SMSF. Our matching questionnaire captures what you need help with, your industry, and your postcode, then connects you with the best-suited firm whose services genuinely overlap. You avoid three 'we don't do that' calls and get to the right person first.How our free matching worksYou answer a short guided questionnaire — usually under 60 seconds — covering what you need help with, your location, and a few details about your situation. We map your answers against our vetted network of registered accountants and return the best-suited qualified match for your specific needs. You then speak directly with that firm. There is no cost, no obligation, and no middleman taking a cut of the advice — the matching service is free to you.
